newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes to halve costs in 6-7 years.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes to halve costs in 6-7 years.

text.p: German car maker Mercedes-Benz AG plans to cut costs by half within six to seven years, chief executive Helmut Werner said on Monday.

Werner also told a public discussion that Mercedes, a unit of Daimler-Benz, expected switching its bookkeeping to the planned Euro currency would cost the company around 100 million marks ($67.1 million). But he added he supported European monetary union.
EMU is scheduled to go ahead in 1999.
